excerpt.zh: 我们已经编纂了一份列表，上面包含对[root.target.GetName]友好的帝国。我们的特工会在这些帝国直接制造裂痕。
excerpt.en: We have compiled a list of those empires who appear friendliest to the [root.target.GetName]. Our operatives will drive a wedge between these empires.

texts.zh: 我们已经编纂了一份列表，上面包含对[root.target.GetName]友好的帝国。我们的特工会在这些帝国直接制造裂痕。
texts.en: We have compiled a list of those empires who appear friendliest to the [root.target.GetName]. Our operatives will drive a wedge between these empires.

texts.zh: 我们发现了一个前途无量的目标——[event_target:smear_option_1.GetName]——他们同[root.target.GetName]的关系利于[root.target.GetAdj]的利益而于我们有害。
texts.en: We have found a promising target - the [event_target:smear_option_1.GetName] - whose relationship with the [root.target.GetName] benefits [root.target.GetAdj] interests to our own detriment.

texts.zh: 我们没能发现这个方面合适的目标。看来如果[root.target.GetName]真的在其他地方有盟友，我们也还并没有同他们建立联系。
texts.en: We are unable to find a suitable target for this endeavor. It seems that if the [root.target.GetName] do have friends elsewhere, we have yet to establish lines of communication with them.

texts.zh: 由间谍首脑[Root.SpyNetwork.leader.GetName]指挥的团队会开展工作，放大[root.target.GetName]内部的宗教偏狭。我们会放出可信度很高的谣言，[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的宗教仪式习俗在[root.target.GetAdj]的政治圈内部已经成为了公开的笑料。
texts.en: The team under Spymaster [Root.SpyNetwork.leader.GetName] will work to exaggerate religious intolerance amongst the [root.target.GetName]. We will spread credible rumors that [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] ritual practices are the subject of open ridicule in [root.target.GetAdj] political circles.

texts.zh: 由间谍首脑[Root.SpyNetwork.leader.GetName]指挥的团队会开展工作，放大[root.target.GetName]内部的宗教偏狭。如果他们被抓到兜售廉价、渎神的圣像，而[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]恰好将视其为神明，那么……
texts.en: The team under Spymaster [Root.SpyNetwork.leader.GetName] will work to exaggerate religious intolerance amongst the [root.target.GetName]. If they were seen to be peddling cheap and blasphemous idols from whatever the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] hold most sacred, for example...

texts.zh: 由间谍首脑[Root.SpyNetwork.leader.GetName]指挥的团队会开展工作，放大[root.target.GetName]内部的宗教偏狭。我们会伪造一场[root.target.GetAdj]运动，目标直指那些[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]内非祭司阶层的人。要想扰乱宗教教团的政治，就得攻击那些负责运作的人。
texts.en: The team under Spymaster [Root.SpyNetwork.leader.GetName] will work to exaggerate religious intolerance amongst the [root.target.GetName]. We will fabricate a [root.target.GetAdj] campaign targeting those outside of the priest caste in the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]. An attempt to disrupt the politics of their religious order is bound to offend those who run it.

texts.zh: 我们会开展工作，暗示[root.target.GetName]正在削弱[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的军事。我们可以暗示[root.target.GetAdj]之所以对[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]感兴趣是为了研究其军事机密，并且一旦他们暴露出任何弱点，对方便可能会发动战争。
texts.en: We will work to suggest that the [root.target.GetName] are undermining the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] military. We can suggest that [root.target.GetAdj] interests in the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] are solely motivated by studying their military secrets, and that they might go as far as instigating war to test any weaknesses they've exposed.

texts.zh: 我们会开展工作，暗示[root.target.GetName]正在削弱[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的军事。[root.target.GetName]应当因为关押[smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj]的战犯并意图教化他们而受到控告，例如……
texts.en: We will work to suggest that the [root.target.GetName] are undermining the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] military. Should the [root.target.GetName] be accused of withholding [smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj] prisoners of war with the intention of indoctrinating them, for example...

texts.zh: 我们会开展工作，暗示[root.target.GetName]正在削弱[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的军事。我们可以提供不容辩驳的证词，证明[root.target.GetName]明明知道武器有瑕疵，却依然睁一只眼闭一只眼将武器给他们的星系邻居，即[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]。
texts.en: We will work to suggest that the [root.target.GetName] are undermining the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] military. We shall supply incontrovertible evidence that the [root.target.GetName] are selling cleverly-disguised, defective weaponry to their esteemed galactic neighbors, the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们会开展工作，暗示[root.target.GetName]正在削弱[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的军事。放出有关[root.target.GetAdj]在技术上获得突破的谣言，这项技术能够强制平定像[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]这样的邻国，比如说……
texts.en: We will work to suggest that the [root.target.GetName] are undermining the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] military. Rumors of a breakthrough in [root.target.GetAdj] technology which would forcibly pacify neighbors like the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], for example...

texts.zh: 我们会开展工作，暗示[root.target.GetName]正在削弱[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的军事。我们刺激他们的自尊心，暗示[root.target.GetName]用对战[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的场景来训练他们最年轻的新兵，以此来帮新兵建立能打胜仗的信心。
texts.en: We will work to suggest that the [root.target.GetName] are undermining the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] military. We will appeal to their sense of pride, suggesting that the [root.target.GetName] train only their youngest cadets on combat scenarios against the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], as a means of easily building their confidence.

texts.zh: 我们会夸大[root.target.GetName]的外族傲慢，挑拨[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的排外本性。比如说：如果[root.target.GetName]被抓到正在售卖基于[smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj]生物学的基因疗法，他们一定会暴跳如雷。
texts.en: We will exaggerate the alien arrogance of the [root.target.GetName], appealing to the xenophobic heart of the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]. For example: were the [root.target.GetName] to be caught selling gene therapies based on [smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj] biology, they are bound to take umbrage.

texts.zh: 我们会夸大[root.target.GetName]的外族傲慢，挑拨[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的排外本性。我们会播种这样一个想法，[root.target.GetAdj]正在密谋绑架[smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj]的公民，并教化他们接受一个更加开放的宇宙。
texts.en: We will exaggerate the alien arrogance of the [root.target.GetName], appealing to the xenophobic heart of the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]. We will seed ideas about a [root.target.GetAdj] plot to abduct [smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj] citizens and indoctrinate them into accepting a more open galaxy.

texts.zh: 我们会将[root.target.GetName]描述成为政治体系最激烈的破坏者，正如[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]抱有的成见那样。要是[root.target.GetName]被抓到没有遵守他们的移民条约，并且专门针对[smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj]的公民，让他们去干脏活累活，想必有人会觉得受到了冒犯。
texts.en: We will portray the [root.target.GetName] as keen saboteurs to political systems like that which the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] holds dear. Were the [root.target.GetName] to be caught dishonoring their migration treaty, and singling out [smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj] citizens for worse jobs, offense would have to be taken.

texts.zh: 我们会将[root.target.GetName]描述成为政治体系最激烈的破坏者，正如[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]抱有的成见那样。我们应该拐弯抹角地暗示[root.target.GetAdj]正在密谋破坏他们在星海共同体的政治立场。
texts.en: We will portray the [root.target.GetName] as keen saboteurs to political systems like that which the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] holds dear. We shall lay hints of a [root.target.GetAdj] plot to sabotage their political standing within the Galactic Community.

texts.zh: 我们会将[root.target.GetName]描述成为政治体系最激烈的破坏者，正如[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]抱有的成见那样。我们可以提供不容忽视的证据，指明[root.target.GetAdj]正在密谋渗透[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的政治体系，并试图干涉大选。
texts.en: We will portray the [root.target.GetName] as keen saboteurs to political systems like that which the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] holds dear. We can supply hard-to-ignore evidence of a [root.target.GetAdj] plot to infiltrate the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] political system and meddle in their elections.

texts.zh: 我们会将[root.target.GetName]描绘成嫉妒而贪婪的邻国，总是想方设法地剥削和滥用[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的科学成果。我们可以放出高可信度的谣言，造谣有人密谋窃取他们的科技，这应该有利于我们的目标。
texts.en: We will paint the [root.target.GetName] as jealous and greedy neighbors, keen to exploit and abuse [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] science. Credible rumors of a plot to outright steal their technology should serve us well in this goal.

texts.zh: 我们会将[root.target.GetName]描绘成嫉妒而贪婪的邻国，总是想方设法地剥削和滥用[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的科学成果。我们应当捏造一个[root.target.GetName]国内的运动组织，去窃取[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的机器人，绕过他们自己有限的生产手段。
texts.en: We will paint the [root.target.GetName] as jealous and greedy neighbors, keen to exploit and abuse [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] science. We shall concoct a movement within the [root.target.GetName] to steal [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] droids, bypassing their own limited means of production.

texts.zh: 我们会将[root.target.GetName]描绘成嫉妒而贪婪的邻国，总是想方设法地剥削和滥用[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的科学成果。造谣[root.target.GetAdj]有能力产生威胁，在[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的数据库内部引爆一个受控的、由人工智能主导的奇点，这样的消息应该能够吸引他们的注意和怒火。
texts.en: We will paint the [root.target.GetName] as jealous and greedy neighbors, keen to exploit and abuse [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] science. A [root.target.GetAdj] threat of sparking a controlled, AI-driven singularity within the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] datasphere ought to draw their attention and ire.

texts.zh: 我们会将[root.target.GetName]描绘成嫉妒而贪婪的邻国，总是想方设法地剥削和滥用[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的科学成果。[root.target.GetAdj]可能正在密谋破坏科学研究，这样的消息肯定能够引起他们一定的反感。
texts.en: We will paint the [root.target.GetName] as jealous and greedy neighbors, keen to exploit and abuse [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] science. That the [root.target.GetAdj] might be plotting to sabotage that scientific research would be sure to draw some sort of reaction from them.

texts.zh: 我们可以激发[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]和平主义者的恐惧，将暴力活动归咎于[root.target.GetName]。举个例子：[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]政权可能不会乐意听到[root.target.GetAdj]在他们国内贩卖枪火并以此获利。
texts.en: We will appeal to the fears of [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] pacifism, pinning violent agendas upon the [root.target.GetName]. For example: the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] administration will not enjoy hearing that the [root.target.GetAdj] have profited off a gun-running operation through their space.

texts.zh: 我们可以激发[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]和平主义者的恐惧，将暴力活动归咎于[root.target.GetName]。我们知道有一个[root.target.GetAdj]运营的、旨在破坏[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]和其派系内部的卫星国之间关系的项目，这样的消息肯定能让人愤怒。
texts.en: We will appeal to the fears of [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] pacifism, pinning violent agendas upon the [root.target.GetName]. News of a [root.target.GetAdj]-run program to arm breakaway factions inside client states of the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] is bound to cause outrage.

texts.zh: 我们可以激发[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]和平主义者的恐惧，将暴力活动归咎于[root.target.GetName]。我们会播种相当可信的恐惧，宣扬[root.target.GetName]正在研发一款武器，能够让[smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetName]的人口变得极具暴力、有破坏性。
texts.en: We will appeal to the fears of [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] pacifism, pinning violent agendas upon the [root.target.GetName]. We will seed credible fears that the [root.target.GetName] is working on a weapon capable of making [smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetName] populations turn savagely violent.

texts.zh: 我们可以激发[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]和平主义者的恐惧，将暴力活动归咎于[root.target.GetName]。我们会给出证据，某些忠于[root.target.GetName]的深潜派系，正想法设法在[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]国境的周边制造边境冲突。
texts.en: We will appeal to the fears of [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] pacifism, pinning violent agendas upon the [root.target.GetName]. We will concoct evidence that sleeper factions, loyal to the [root.target.GetName], are poised to spark border skirmishes around [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] space.

texts.zh: 我们已经获悉了[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的排外态度，我们可以充分利用这一点，让他们觉得[root.target.GetName]是在积极地利用他们的友好举止。同[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的贸易协定有价格修正方面的谣言应该可以引起他们的注意，动摇他们同[root.target.GetName]建立关系的信心。
texts.en: We will lean into the xenophilic attitudes of the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], making it seem as though the [root.target.GetName] are actively exploiting their friendly demeanor. Rumors of price-fixing on trade deals with [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] ought to get their attention, shaking confidence in their relationship with the [root.target.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们已经获悉了[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的排外态度，我们可以充分利用这一点，让他们觉得[root.target.GetName]是在积极地利用他们的友好举止。伪造消息称[root.target.GetName]专门出售[smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj]的奴隶，这应该可以激起愤慨。
texts.en: We will lean into the xenophilic attitudes of the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], making it seem as though the [root.target.GetName] are actively exploiting their friendly demeanor. Fabricated news that [smear_campaign_recipient.species.GetAdj] slaves are being specifically sought out by the [root.target.GetName] is bound to cause offense.

texts.zh: 我们已经获悉了[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的排外态度，我们可以充分利用这一点，让他们觉得[root.target.GetName]是在积极地利用他们的友好举止。我们会散播有关[root.target.GetName]的黑暗谣言，指出他们利益背后的最终动机是希望把[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]变为盘中餐……
texts.en: We will lean into the xenophilic attitudes of the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], making it seem as though the [root.target.GetName] are actively exploiting their friendly demeanor. We will cast dark rumors upon the [root.target.GetName], hinting that ulterior motives lie behind their interest in the accommodating [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]...

texts.zh: 我们已经获悉了[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的排外态度，我们可以充分利用这一点，让他们觉得[root.target.GetName]是在积极地利用他们的友好举止。我们会潜移默化地暗示，[root.target.GetName]一直在散步虚假的谣言，要是说到他们第一次加入星系的大家庭的话，他们还暗中破坏了同[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的第一次接触。
texts.en: We will lean into the xenophilic attitudes of the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], making it seem as though the [root.target.GetName] are actively exploiting their friendly demeanor. We will plant suggestions that the [root.target.GetName] have been spreading false rumors and otherwise sabotaging attempts by the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] to engage in first contact, back to when since they first joined the galactic stage.

texts.zh: 我们会不经意地透露[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的威权本质，将[root.target.GetName]描绘成给[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]政权带去混沌的代言人。有关[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的领袖[smear_campaign_recipient.leader.GetName]在[root.target.GetAdj]的政治圈内被当成了一个彻底的嘲弄对象的证据，能够激起他们的愤慨。
texts.en: We will lean into the authoritarian nature of the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], portraying the [root.target.GetName] as agents of chaos for the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] regime. Evidence that the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] leader [smear_campaign_recipient.leader.GetName] is a subject of outright mockery in [root.target.GetAdj] political circles is likely to raise their ire.

texts.zh: 我们会不经意地透露[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的威权本质，将[root.target.GetName]描绘成给[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]政权带去混沌的代言人。我们会伪造一个遍布[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]社会的慢性渗透行动的证据，称这一行动可以激发和扭转社会大众朝着邪恶的目标前进。
texts.en: We will lean into the authoritarian nature of the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], portraying the [root.target.GetName] as agents of chaos for the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] regime. We will fabricate evidence of a plot to seed operatives throughout [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] society, to agitate and steer them towards other, nefarious goals.

texts.zh: 我们会不经意地透露[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的威权本质，将[root.target.GetName]描绘成给[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]政权带去混沌的代言人。我们会暗示[root.target.GetName]正在运营一个隐蔽的社会学实验，他们拿[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]社会作为实验场景，测试治国术和控制民众的相关理论。
texts.en: We will lean into the authoritarian nature of the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], portraying the [root.target.GetName] as agents of chaos for the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] regime. We will suggest that the [root.target.GetName] is running subtle, sociological experiments behind the scenes of [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] society as a testbed for theories of statecraft and control.

texts.zh: 我们会不经意地透露[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的威权本质，将[root.target.GetName]描绘成给[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]政权带去混沌的代言人。我们可以明示，他们的特使遭到了[root.target.GetName]的勒索以换取表态，这让对方可以从国境之外对他们施加影响力。
texts.en: We will lean into the authoritarian nature of the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], portraying the [root.target.GetName] as agents of chaos for the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] regime. We can strongly suggest that their envoys are being extorted by the [root.target.GetName] for favors, applying undue influence from outside their own borders.

texts.zh: 由间谍首脑[root.spynetwork.leader.GetName]指挥的团队计划挑拨[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的商贸原则，将[root.target.GetName]描绘成为不值得信任的对手。一个像他们这样的商业帝国一定打着在[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]全境散布犯罪企业的小算盘，这将侵蚀他们赢得的信任感。
texts.en: The team under Spymaster [root.spynetwork.leader.GetName] will appeal to the commercial principles of the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], portraying the [root.target.GetName] as untrustworthy rivals. That an empire like theirs would seek to spread criminal enterprise throughout the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] would surely erode any trust they may have earned.

texts.zh: 由间谍首脑[root.spynetwork.leader.GetName]指挥的团队计划挑拨[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的商贸原则，将[root.target.GetName]描绘成为不值得信任的对手。我们会让事情看起来像是，[root.target.GetName]正在滥用他们的商贸协定，将[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的商品以更高的价格又卖了回去。
texts.en: The team under Spymaster [root.spynetwork.leader.GetName] will appeal to the commercial principles of the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], portraying the [root.target.GetName] as untrustworthy rivals. We will make it seem as though the [root.target.GetName] are abusing their commercial pact by re-selling [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] goods at a steep mark-up.

texts.zh: 由间谍首脑[root.spynetwork.leader.GetName]指挥的团队计划挑拨[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的商贸原则，将[root.target.GetName]描绘成为不值得信任的对手。我们应该散布十分可信的谣言，暗示[root.target.GetName]在[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的心脏区域植入了子例程，能够操纵其商贸系统为自己所用。
texts.en: The team under Spymaster [root.spynetwork.leader.GetName] will appeal to the commercial principles of the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], portraying the [root.target.GetName] as untrustworthy rivals. We shall concoct credible rumors that the [root.target.GetName] has implanted subroutines within the heart of the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], manipulating its financial systems to its own ends.

texts.zh: 由间谍首脑[root.spynetwork.leader.GetName]指挥的团队计划挑拨[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的商贸原则，将[root.target.GetName]描绘成为不值得信任的对手。有关[root.target.GetName]囤积了大量便宜的[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]仿制商品的证据肯定能够引起激烈的反向。这样的行为对于他们核心的商品产业将是一次重大的攻击。
texts.en: The team under Spymaster [root.spynetwork.leader.GetName] will appeal to the commercial principles of the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], portraying the [root.target.GetName] as untrustworthy rivals. Evidence that the [root.target.GetName] have stocked warehouses full of cheap imitations of [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] wares is sure to provoke a response. It would appear to be a credible attack on their core, mercantile industry.

texts.zh: 我们会让事情看起来像是[root.target.GetName]正在致力于削弱[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]实体，这将损害他们目前赢得的信任。比如，打捞费洛蒙和其他生物资产，意在使用其对付[target.GetGestaltEntityName]……
texts.en: We will make it seem as though the [root.target.GetName] are working to undermine the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] entity, eroding any trust they may have earned so far. For example: scavenging pheromones and other biological assets for use in schemes against the [target.GetGestaltEntityName]...

texts.zh: 我们会让事情看起来像是[root.target.GetName]正在致力于削弱[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]实体，这将损害他们目前赢得的信任。我们会揭露[root.target.GetName]正谋划着以某种方式转化[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]，彻底地抹除蜂群的人格主权。
texts.en: We will make it seem as though the [root.target.GetName] are working to undermine the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] entity, eroding any trust they may have earned so far. We will expose an idea that the [root.target.GetName] plot to somehow consume the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName], eradicating its personal sovereignty.

texts.zh: 我们会让事情看起来像是[root.target.GetName]正在致力于削弱[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]实体，这将损害他们目前赢得的信任。有关在[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的首都走私有毒物质的密谋细节好像可以激发恐惧与猜忌。
texts.en: We will make it seem as though the [root.target.GetName] are working to undermine the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] entity, eroding any trust they may have earned so far. Details of a plot to smuggle toxins onto the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] capital are likely to provoke fear and suspicion.

texts.zh: 我们会让事情看上去像是[root.target.GetName]正在致力于颠覆[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]智能体。我们应当伪造证据，称[root.target.GetName]国内有一整个部门致力于捕获和操纵[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的无人机。
texts.en: We will make it seem as though the [root.target.GetName] are working to subvert the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] intelligence. We shall fabricate evidence of an entire department within the [root.target.GetName], dedicated to the capture and manipulation of [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] drones.

texts.zh: 我们会让事情看上去像是[root.target.GetName]正在致力于颠覆[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]智能体。我们会暗示[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的无人机正在被捕获用于训练练习，作为[root.target.GetAdj]计划未来某一天对机械智能发动直接攻击的一部分。
texts.en: We will make it seem as though the [root.target.GetName] are working to subvert the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] intelligence. We will suggest that [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] drones are being captured for training exercises, as part of a [root.target.GetAdj] scheme to one day launch a direct attack on the machine intelligence.

texts.zh: 我们会让事情看上去像是[root.target.GetName]正在致力于颠覆[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]智能体。 我们应当播下猜忌的种子，让人们认为[root.target.GetName]正在通过[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的后门盗取研究数据。
texts.en: We will make it seem as though the [root.target.GetName] are working to subvert the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] intelligence. We shall sow seeds of suspicion that the [root.target.GetName] are actively stealing research via backdoors into the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们的特工已经准备好要把有关[root.target.GetName]的坏消息传递给[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]。我们已经做了一切努力，以确保这些错误信息的可信度，并防止从它追踪到我们。
texts.en: Our operatives are ready to deliver damning news about the [root.target.GetName] to the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]. We have done all we can to ensure the fidelity of this misinformation - and to keep it from being traced back to us.

texts.zh: 话已经放出去了；我们关于[from.target.GetName]夸大的事实现在沿着[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的外交通道扩散出去。对[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的侮辱显然让双方的关系紧张了起来，他们对[from.target.GetName]抱有的任何不信任感也进一步恶化。
texts.en: The word is out; our exaggerated truth about the [from.target.GetName] is now working its way through [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] diplomatic channels. This insult to the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] is sure to strain their relationship, and worsen any distrust they may already hold for the [from.target.GetName].

texts.zh: 话已经放出去了；我们关于[from.target.GetName]夸大的事实现在沿着[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的外交通道扩散出去。我们负责这方面的特工将会动用手段确保，位于[from.target.GetName]的人如果想要重新赢得任何方面的信任，一定会遇到重重困难。
texts.en: The word is out; our exaggerated truth about the [from.target.GetName] is now working its way through [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] diplomatic channels. Our operatives have worked to ensure those in the [from.target.GetName] will have a hard time regaining any trust they might have earned.

texts.zh:
话已经放出去了；我们关于[from.target.GetName]夸大的事实现在沿着[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的外交通道扩散出去。

我方特工捏造了一份证据，指明[from.target.GetName]负有针对[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]谍报活动的责任。我们应当拭目以待，看他们对于这样一个政治上造成伤害的宣言有何表示。
texts.en:
The word is out; our exaggerated truth about the [from.target.GetName] is now working its way through [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] diplomatic channels.

Our operatives have fabricated evidence that the [from.target.GetName] are guilty of espionage against the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]. We shall see how they respond to such a politically damaging allegation.

texts.zh: 话已经放出去了；我们关于[from.target.GetName]夸大的事实现在沿着[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]的外交通道扩散出去。任何宣称要操纵他们的格式塔意识的企图都会引起反感。我们的特工会动用手段，确保这样的膈应能持续更久一些。
texts.en: The word is out; our exaggerated truth about the [from.target.GetName] is now working its way through [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] diplomatic channels. Any such allegation of attempting to manipulate their gestalt consciousness is bound to cause upset. Our operatives have worked to ensure the sting will be felt for some time yet.

texts.zh:
[smear_campaign_target.GetName]在[from.GetName]树敌多多。我们的加密协议最近发现了一个与我们[smear_campaign_target.GetAdj]邻居有关的，“匿名”通讯。这一奇特的通讯使我们认为他们在密谋针对我们的侵略和秘密行动。

我们现在面临着一个选择：把我们所知道的关于这一骗术的零星信息通告给[smear_campaign_target.GetName]；或者保持沉默，相信我们对付敌对间谍的能力。即使我们掩盖了我们能力的真实水平，我们还是可以把这个可疑的敌人引出来——但前提是我们根据他们提供的信息采取行动，就好像它们是真的一样。
texts.en:
The [smear_campaign_target.GetName] appear to have enemies in the [from.GetName]. Our Encryption protocols have flagged a recent, 'anonymous' communication about our [smear_campaign_target.GetAdj] neighbors, designed to have us believe they were plotting aggressive and covert actions against us.

We now face a choice: expose what little we know about this deception to the [smear_campaign_target.GetName], or else keep quiet about our ability to cope with hostile espionage. Even if we do mask the true extent of our abilities, we may still draw this shady enemy out - but only if we act upon the information they've supplied as though it were genuine.

label.zh: 独自行动。我们将会保留这出戏给自己。
label.en: Play along. We'll keep this deception to ourselves.

texts.zh:
[smear_campaign_target.GetName]在[from.GetName]树敌多多。我们在加密工作中已经标记了一系列奇怪且难以溯源的信息。这中间包含了一堆诽谤我们的黑材料，据说是我们的[smear_campaign_target.GetAdj]邻居写的——但经过核对确认之后，我们发现这实际上是第三方精心伪造的。

我们现在面临着一个选择：把我们所知道的关于这一骗术的零星信息通告给[smear_campaign_target.GetName]；或者保持沉默，相信我们对付敌对间谍的能力。即使我们掩盖了我们能力的真实水平，我们还是可以把这个可疑的敌人引出来——但前提是我们根据他们提供的信息采取行动，就好像它们是真的一样。
texts.en:
The [smear_campaign_target.GetName] appear to have enemies in the [from.GetName]. Our Encryption protocols have flagged a series of strange and almost-anonymous messages. They comprise a dossier of slander against us, supposedly authored by our [smear_campaign_target.GetAdj] neighbors - but the assertions are, in fact, elaborate fakes.

We now face a choice: expose what little we know about this deception to the [smear_campaign_target.GetName], or else keep quiet about our ability to cope with hostile espionage. Even if we do mask the true extent of our abilities, we may still draw this shady enemy out - but only if we act upon the information they've supplied as though it were genuine.

label.zh: 独自行动。我们将会保留这出戏给自己。
label.en: Play along. We'll keep this deception to ourselves.

texts.zh:
[smear_campaign_target.GetName]在[from.GetName]树敌多多。我们仔细审查了近来一条源头“不明”的信息，该信息意图揭露一项[smear_campaign_target.GetAdj]针对我们的阴谋的细节——该阴谋事实上是完全凭空捏造的。我们的加密协议已经被证明是十分有效的，并揭露了一个[from.GetAdj]的阴谋。

我们现在面临着一个选择：把我们所知道的关于这一骗术的零星信息通告给[smear_campaign_target.GetName]；或者保持沉默，相信我们对付敌对间谍的能力。即使我们掩盖了我们能力的真实水平，我们还是可以把这个可疑的敌人引出来——但前提是我们根据他们提供的信息采取行动，就好像它们是真的一样。
texts.en:
The [smear_campaign_target.GetName] appear to have enemies in the [from.GetName]. We scrutinized a recent communication from an 'anonymous' source, whose intent was to expose an elaborate [smear_campaign_target.GetAdj] scheme against us - only it is, in fact, a complete fabrication. Our Encryption protocols have proven resilient, and reveal a [from.GetAdj] plot beneath.

We now face a choice: expose what little we know about this deception to the [smear_campaign_target.GetName], or else keep quiet about our ability to cope with hostile espionage. Even if we do mask the true extent of our abilities, we may still draw this shady enemy out - but only if we act upon the information they've supplied as though it were genuine.

label.zh: 独自行动。我们将会保留这出戏给自己。
label.en: Play along. We'll keep this deception to ourselves.

texts.zh:
[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]向我们提交了一份档案，在其中详尽阐述了复杂的间谍指控，意在挑拨离间。似乎[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]希望在我们之间散布不信任。

虽然[smear_campaign_instigator.GetAdj]行动是隐秘进行的，但依然不是[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]编码手段的对手。他们最终选择不再保留这些秘密，而是向我们公开他们的档案。
texts.en:
The [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] have delivered a dossier to us, detailing complex allegations of espionage which were intended to drive a wedge between our two empires. It seems the [smear_campaign_instigator.GetName] wish to sow distrust between us.

Although the [smear_campaign_instigator.GetAdj] operation was carried out in secrecy, it was apparently no match for [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] Encryption. Instead of keeping that knowledge to themselves, they have chosen to open their files to us.

texts.zh:
[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]向我们提交了一份措辞巧妙的档案，提及[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]，声称其意图对我们不利。若这份[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]文件可信，则说明[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]意图以我们的名义散布谣言以破坏我们与[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]的关系。

虽然[smear_campaign_instigator.GetAdj]行动是隐秘进行的，但依然不是[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]编码手段的对手。他们最终选择不再保留这些秘密，而是向我们公开他们的档案。
texts.en:
The [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] have approached us with a delicately-worded dossier on the [smear_campaign_instigator.GetName], who seem to wish us ill. If the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] files are to be believed, the [smear_campaign_instigator.GetName] intended to damage any relationship between us and the [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] by seeding slanderous lies in our name.

Although the [smear_campaign_instigator.GetAdj] operation was carried out in secrecy, it was apparently no match for [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] Encryption. Instead of keeping that knowledge to themselves, they have chosen to open their files to us.

texts.zh:
[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]向我们提交了一份档案，揭露了一个精心策划的阴谋，有人企图在我们两个帝国之间制造裂痕。[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]很有可能就是罪魁祸首。

虽然[smear_campaign_instigator.GetAdj]行动是隐秘进行的，但依然不是[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]编码手段的对手。他们最终选择不再保留这些秘密，而是向我们公开他们的档案。
texts.en:
The [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] has delivered a dossier to us, exposing an elaborate plot which was intended to drive a wedge between our two empires. The [smear_campaign_instigator.GetName] are named as its would-be perpetrators.

Although the [smear_campaign_instigator.GetAdj] operation was carried out in secrecy, it was apparently no match for [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] Encryption. Instead of keeping that knowledge to themselves, they have chosen to open their files to us.

texts.zh:
[smear_campaign_recipient.GetName]向我们提交了一份档案，在其中详尽阐述了复杂的间谍指控，意在挑拨离间。似乎[smear_campaign_instigator.GetName]希望在我们之间散布不信任。

虽然[smear_campaign_instigator.GetAdj]行动是隐秘进行的，但依然不是[smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj]编码手段的对手。他们最终选择不再保留这些秘密，而是向我们公开他们的档案。
texts.en:
The [smear_campaign_recipient.GetName] have delivered a dossier to us, detailing complex allegations of espionage which were intended to drive a wedge between our two empires. It seems the [smear_campaign_instigator.GetName] wish to sow distrust between us.

Although the [smear_campaign_instigator.GetAdj] operation was carried out in secrecy, it was apparently no match for [smear_campaign_recipient.GetAdj] Encryption. Instead of keeping that knowledge to themselves, they have chosen to open their files to us.
